purpose: Correct the live PostHog public_page_view amplification discovered during genuine REG.RU mobile acceptance without widening the accepted public analytics privacy, identity, route or production boundaries.
effectiveAfter: This governance manifest is merged to main. The implementation branch must then synchronize to that accepted main and stay within the finite path set below.
requiredInvariants: A same-route Server Action reference refresh or React remount must not emit another automatic public_page_view or reset the bounded per-route event budget.
An actual pathname transition may establish a fresh route lifecycle; a full browser reload may establish a fresh tab runtime lifecycle.
Ordinary allowlisted product analytics events must continue to use the latest Server Action callback without rearming automatic page-view capture.
The behavioral regression remains inside the already-accounted publicAnalyticsBoundary unit suite; no unregistered test surface is introduced.
Session replay, autocapture and browser-side PostHog SDK loading remain disabled.
Analytics remains fail-closed outside the existing public allowlist plus exact /platform-v7; no descendant /platform-v7/* route becomes eligible by prefix.
The browser sends analytics only to the existing Next.js application boundary; third-party capture remains server-side, bounded and fail-soft.
No event-name, property, free-text, PII, URL, auth, tenant, registration, RBAC, database, CSP, release-topology or external-host allowlist is widened by this fix.
Person-profile suppression and geo-IP enrichment disablement remain enforced by the existing server capture boundary.
No new npm dependency, recurring paid infrastructure commitment or non-web production mutation is introduced by this scope.
